name: run_command
description: Run a shell command or complex shell script for testing, building, checks, and scripted tasks. For long-running commands (builds, dev servers, batch jobs) use background=true to run detached and attach a short title: a short job_id is returned immediately; use job(action=status) to check progress and output, job(action=stop) to stop; when the command finishes the system will automatically notify you to follow up. Prefer apply_patch for editing files; do not write source code files via shell heredoc/cat/tee unless the user explicitly asks. Inside scripts you can call structured tools under this session's identity with `miyu tool-call <name> --stdin`; --list shows exactly the set callable in this session, and --describe shows a tool's parameter contract — bash loops plus pipes are the orchestration layer, and intermediate data does not pass through the model context. Inner calls execute in the daemon-side session workspace: they do not inherit the script's environment variables or current directory; pass data across tools via parameter JSON or files.

command.description: The shell command or script to run. May contain complex multi-line commands; prefer apply_patch for file edits.

timeout_seconds.description: Optional timeout in seconds. Ignored when background=true.

background.description: Run detached in the background and return a short job_id immediately. Suitable for commands expected to take longer than about 30 seconds.

title.description: Short title for the background command (at most 16 characters), shown in the UI status line, e.g. “release build”. Recommended when background=true.
